name: Footer Placeholder 2
text: One-way audio delay target: 95th percentile at most 150 ms.
textPreview: One-way audio delay target: 95th percentile at most 150 ms.

text: Sources: ClassMic aspiration, business case and charter. The targets cover scope completion, usable setup and speaking, perceived audibility, and instructor control. Ready-speaker trials measure time from instructor approval to audible speech. Audio transport delay is measured separately, with median and 95th percentile reported and a proposed 95th percentile target of 150 milliseconds.
